title: CPR Rescue Breathing
description: Step-by-step CPR updated to the 2025 American Heart Association guidelines: compression depth and rate, hands-only CPR, AED use, and how child and infant CPR differ. Covers choking victims who become unresponsive, drowning, overdose, pregnancy, and when to stop.
shortDescription: 2025 AHA CPR for adults, children, and infants, hands-only CPR, and AEDs
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
